authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES the R-6 process-death cleanup and R-10 expiry-limb initial states from permission-truth-tables.v9 as leftover beyond OBL-FX-AUTHORING's fourteen FX classes. v2 restores r10Verbatim to the full live v9 race+outcome (445 characters) and carries both whyDeterministic strings, the same truncation class as CLAUDE-FX5-SF1 / CLAUDE-FX6-SF1. It does not author journal bytes. It does not invent an expiry-age number. It does not invent a cleanup-bound number. It does not evaluate expiry by wall-clock now. It does not execute R-6 or R-10. It does not close OBL-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-105. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of the G09-named R-6 and R-10 limbs without inventing journal or clock envelopes. v2 restores the dropped R-10 parenthetical and the DR-G09-forbids clause so a later fixture cannot treat wall-clock now as order. The limbs are not executed here.

pttV9.r6Verbatim: PROCESS DEATH mid-cleanup. Recovery re-runs cleanup from the journal. Every inverse is idempotent by its effect class's own declaration, so re-running is safe by construction. Cleanup's bound is measured from the recovery, and exhausting it journals a residual rather than looping.
pttV9.r6WhyDeterministic: Idempotence is a precondition of an effect class being called reversible at all, per effectCommitDefinitions.default -- so this case needs no special reasoning, which is the point of putting the requirement in the definition.
pttV9.r10Verbatim: An EXPIRY falling between acceptance and commit-intent. Expiry is materialized as a journaled record at the sequence where the host observes it, and it behaves exactly as REV from that point (bar future requests, cancel and clean up what is reversible, disclose what completed). It is NOT evaluated by comparing a wall-clock expiry timestamp against a wall-clock now at commit time; doing so would make the clock the order, which DR-G09 forbids.
pttV9.r10WhyDeterministic: The expiry RECORD, not the expiry TIME, is what other records are ordered against.

r6r10V1.role: Predecessor. Unmoved. r6Verbatim already equalled live race+outcome at 281 of 281. r10Verbatim was 295 characters against live race+outcome 445: it dropped the parenthetical '(bar future requests, cancel and clean up what is reversible, disclose what completed)' and the clause '; doing so would make the clock the order, which DR-G09 forbids.' This v2 does not reuse the v1 version number.

g09v3.role: Claude ACCEPT 0/0; Codex not reviewed. Not applied. Names R-10 expiry limb and R-6 process-death cleanup. Not FX-15.
